user.title: Select Schneider Ambient device
user.description: Select a Schneider/WSC mirror or mirror cabinet currently visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Schneider Ambient BLE
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}. If the cabinet requires pairing, put it into pairing mode before confirming. Pairing/bonding is still being validated.

abort.device_not_found: The selected device is no longer visible. Put the cabinet into pairing mode and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No compatible Schneider/WSC device was found. Make sure a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online, then put the cabinet into pairing mode and try again.
abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.
